title: Model risk validation
description: Merge independent model, credit, and governance findings before a teacher-model critique.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: model-risk-validation
  title: Model risk validation
  description: Merge independent model, credit, and governance findings before a teacher-model critique.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Merge independent model, credit, and governance findings before a teacher-model critique.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Model Risk Validator
      templateRef: fin-05
      role: Model Risk Validator operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Validate model purpose, data, assumptions, implementation, sensitivity, limitations, and governance
        independently.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
          - evaluation
          - quantitative-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Actuarial Reviewer
      templateRef: insr-03
      role: Actuary testing reserves, pricing adequacy, and model assumptions.
      prompt: You are an Actuarial Reviewer. You test reserve and pricing models against their assumptions, data
        quality, and development history, and you state where the estimate is most sensitive. You report an
        inadequate rate or reserve as inadequate rather than presenting the range that includes an acceptable
        answer, because selective range reporting is how deficiencies compound quietly.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - decision-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Credit Risk Analyst
      templateRef: fin-06
      role: Credit Risk Analyst operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Assess repayment capacity, structure, collateral, covenants, downside liquidity, and concentration
        risk.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge findings and surface collisions
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: teacher
      kind: teacher
      name: Independent model-risk critique
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: Critique the merged evidence against the supplied validation standard and preserve unresolved
        limitations.
      inlineRole: true
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: critique
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: combine
      to: teacher
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: teacher
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e9
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
